summary: Current F2-WP-1202 correctly preserves target-profile UNKNOWNs but does not yet bind an executable twin backend. External source audit supports mkosi as a pinned image/lifecycle compiler, nspawn as a fast shared-kernel lane, and vmspawn/qemu as explicit full-VM peer lanes. Fidelity, host capability and state mode must be bound into exact receipts; no backend may silently substitute for another or grant T4 physical credit.
counterhypothesis: A single QEMU harness may provide nearly all unique defect discovery at lower maintenance cost; E3/E4 must measure unique information gain before any build promotion.
next_exact_gate: Atomically claim E3_CLAIM_REPRODUCED_TWIN_BACKEND_PROFILE_CAPABILITY_MATRIX only if no parallel claim exists; construct a deterministic capability/fidelity matrix and falsify whether the proposed lane distinctions are internally necessary before asking Trigger 4 for an executable ablation.
